```{r}
# PRIME Screen
# https://doi.org/10.1016/j.schres.2008.08.018
# Scoring instructions: Sum of the 12 items. 

# Load required packages 
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
PRIME <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/prime.tsv")


# Compute total scores for each individual participant
PRIME <- PRIME %>%
  mutate(
    prime_total_score    = rowSums(select(., prime_1, prime_2, prime_3, prime_4, prime_5, prime_6, prime_7, prime_8, prime_9, prime_10, prime_11, prime_12), na.rm = TRUE),
  )%>%
  rename_with(tolower)

write_tsv(PRIME,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/prime.tsv", na = "n/a")

```
``` {r PRIME distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

PRIME %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prime_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "PRIME total score (sum of 12 items)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of PRIME total scores")

```
